title: Judgment and Grace over Israel and Judah
description: Through a powerful marriage metaphor, the Lord describes how Israel (the Northern Kingdom) was divorced from Him due to idolatry, while Judah (the Southern Kingdom) still chose to commit adultery. The chapter contains an invitation to repentance, promises of new shepherds, and a future where the ark of the covenant will no longer be needed because Jerusalem itself will be called the Lord's throne.
